hypothesis: Stocks do not break out alone: sector rotation provides the bid underneath. A breakout in a leading sector rides institutional sector-allocation flows.
mechanism: Breakout in a leading sector = tailwind from sector flows; breakout in a lagging sector fights its own sector's gravity. Sector-level participation, complementary to stock-level RS.
bucketing: quartile primary (top 25% / middle 50% / bottom 25%), tercile robustness; cross-sectional rank on the 123-name working universe, strict PIT
blinding: 14 names masked from construction, ranking, evaluation
